NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "SelectHammerstone_Description", "Examine river cobbles to find one with the right weight and shape to fit comfortably in your palm. Our ancestors spent two million years perfecting this selection - a good hammerstone becomes an extension of the arm.")

NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "StrikeFlakes_Description", "Strike one stone against another at the correct angle to detach thin, sharp flakes. This simple act - discovered 2.6 million years ago - was humanitys first deliberate tool creation. The flakes produced are waste to the toolmaker but treasure to those who recognize their cutting potential.")

NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "ShapeChopper_Description", "Remove flakes from one end of a cobble to create a rough chopping edge - the defining tool of Oldowan technology. For over a million years, this was the height of human innovation.")

NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "ShapeScraper_Description", "Carefully retouch a sharp flake to create a steep, sturdy scraping edge. The Oldowan knappers discovered that different angles served different purposes - the scraper was one of humanitys first specialized tools.")

NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "KnapFlintFlakes_Description", "Strike flakes from a flint nodule. Flint fractures according to precise physical laws, producing edges sharper than surgical steel - a vast improvement over common stone.")

NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "KnapFlintKnife_Description", "Carefully retouch a flint flake to create a durable blade with one sharp edge and one blunt edge for safe handling. The conchoidal fracture of flint produces edges only molecules thick.")

NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "KnapBifacialHandaxe_Description", "Shape a large flint nodule from both faces to create a symmetrical teardrop form - the hallmark of Acheulean technology. This elegant design produces four times more cutting edge than Oldowan choppers.")

NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "CookMeat_Description", "Roast meat over the fire until done. The control of fire transformed human nutrition - cooking breaks down proteins, kills parasites, and releases more calories.")

NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "StripBark_Description", "Carefully peel thin layers of papery bark from a birch branch. The bark separates most easily in early spring when the sap rises - a technique humans have used for over fifty thousand years.")

NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "ShredBark_Description", "Tear and shred birch bark to separate the inner bast fibers. These long, flexible strands were the basis of Neanderthal cordage technology - evidence of which dates back at least 50,000 years.")

NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "TwistCordage_Description", "Twist fibers clockwise into yarn, then twist two yarns counter-clockwise together. This opposing twist locks the fibers in tension - a deceptively complex technique that enabled snares, hafted tools, and countless other technologies.")

NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "ShapeDiggingStick_Description", "Select a hardwood branch and sharpen one end to a point using a stone flake. This most basic of tools unlocks the calories stored in underground tubers.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "SelectClub_Description", "Find a heavy branch with good heft for striking. Sometimes the simplest weapon is best.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "GatherTinder_Description", "Collect fine, dry materials that will catch a spark - shredded bark, dried grass, or fungal amadou.")

NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeFireDrill_Description", "Carve a straight hardwood spindle and prepare a softwood fireboard with a notched depression. The hand drill is one of humanitys oldest fire-starting methods.")

NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeBowDrill_Description", "A bow-driven spindle generates more heat with less effort than a hand drill. The addition of a bearing block and bow transforms fire-making from exhausting work to reliable technique.")

NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "ScrapeHide_Description", "Remove flesh and fat from a fresh hide using a stone scraper. Speed is essential - an untreated hide begins rotting within hours.")

NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "BrainTanHide_Description", "Work animal brains into a scraped hide, then smoke it to produce soft, washable buckskin. Every animal has just enough brain to tan its own hide.")

NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "HaftSpear_Description", "Bind a sharpened point to a straight shaft using cordage. The first composite tools combined materials with different properties.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "HaftFlintSpear_Description", "Attach a carefully knapped flint point to a spear shaft. The flint tip penetrates far deeper than wood alone.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeSimplePouch_Description", "Gather a single piece of leather and tie it with sinew to create a basic container.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "CraftSimpleBow_Description", "Shape a bow stave and string it with twisted sinew or plant fiber. The bow stores energy for instant release.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "FletchArrows_Description", "Attach fletching and points to straight shafts. Fletching stabilizes flight through drag.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "CraftAtlatl_Description", "Carve a hooked throwing stick that effectively extends the arm, doubling spear velocity.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "CraftAtlatlDart_Description", "Make lightweight darts designed for atlatl throwing - longer and more flexible than hand-thrown spears.")

NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeFishSpear_Description", "Create a multi-pronged spear for fishing in shallows. The spread of points compensates for light refraction in water.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "WeaveFishTrap_Description", "Weave a conical basket trap that allows fish to enter but not escape.")

NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "KnapMicroliths_Description", "Create tiny, geometric stone bladelets for composite tools. These small pieces maximize cutting edge per unit of precious stone.")

NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "SewLeatherTunic_Description", "Cut and stitch leather pieces into a garment covering the torso. Sewn clothing enabled human expansion into cold climates.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "SewLeatherTrousers_Description", "Stitch leather leg coverings for travel through brush and cold weather.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "SewLeatherBoots_Description", "Create foot coverings from thick leather with sewn soles.")

NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeBoneNeedle_Description", "Grind and polish a bone splinter into a fine needle with a drilled eye. This tiny tool enabled the revolution of sewn clothing.")

NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "CarveDugoutCanoe_Description", "Hollow a large log using fire and stone adzes. This labor-intensive process creates humanitys first true watercraft.")

NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakePolishedAxe_Description", "Grind and polish a greenstone blank against sandstone until smooth. Polished axes cut faster and last longer than flaked tools.")

NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeCompositeBow_Description", "Layer horn, wood, and sinew to create a bow more powerful than its size suggests. A masterwork of materials science.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "BuildDeadfall_Description", "Construct a triggered trap that drops a heavy weight on prey. Passive hunting that works while you sleep.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeSnare_Description", "Create a noose trap that tightens when triggered. Snares catch small game with minimal effort.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "WeaveBasket_Description", "Interlace flexible plant materials into a lightweight container for gathering and storage.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeWaterSkin_Description", "Clean an animal bladder or stomach for use as a water container.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeBarkContainer_Description", "Fold and stitch birch bark into a waterproof vessel.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeQuiver_Description", "Construct a leather container for carrying and protecting arrows.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "ShapeCrudePottery_Description", "Pinch and coil clay into a simple vessel, then fire it in an open fire.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeCookingPot_Description", "Create a thick-walled ceramic vessel designed to withstand direct flame.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeStorageJar_Description", "Build a large ceramic container for storing grain and other goods.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeClayBowl_Description", "Form a shallow ceramic vessel for serving and eating.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeGrindingStone_Description", "Shape a flat stone for grinding grain into flour.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeSickle_Description", "Set sharp flint bladelets into a curved wooden handle for harvesting grain.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeHoe_Description", "Attach a flat stone blade to a wooden handle for tilling soil.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeSpindle_Description", "Create a weighted spindle for spinning fiber into thread.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "SpinWoolThread_Description", "Draw out and twist wool fibers into continuous thread.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "SpinFlaxThread_Description", "Spin processed flax fibers into linen thread.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "WeaveCloth_Description", "Interlace threads on a loom to create fabric.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeSimpleLoom_Description", "Construct a basic frame loom for weaving cloth.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "SewClothTunic_Description", "Cut and stitch cloth into a comfortable garment.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "HammerNativeCopper_Description", "Cold-work native copper into simple shapes through hammering.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "CastCopperAwl_Description", "Melt copper in a crucible and cast a pointed tool for leather working.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "SmeltCopperOre_Description", "Extract copper from malachite ore using high-temperature smelting.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "AlloyBronze_Description", "Combine copper and tin to create bronze - harder than either metal alone.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "ForgeBronzeAxe_Description", "Cast and hammer a bronze axe head, then haft it to a wooden handle.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "ForgeBronzeSword_Description", "Craft a leaf-shaped bronze blade - the first true swords.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "ForgeBronzeSpearhead_Description", "Cast a socketed bronze spearhead for mounting on a wooden shaft.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "ForgeBronzeKnife_Description", "Hammer out a bronze knife blade and fit it with a handle.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeSmithHammer_Description", "Craft a heavy hammer for metalworking.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeLeatherArmor_Description", "Layer and harden leather into protective body armor.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeWoodenShield_Description", "Construct a wooden shield faced with rawhide for protection in combat.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "ForgeBronzeHelmet_Description", "Hammer sheet bronze into a protective helmet.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "ForgeBronzeShield_Description", "Create a shield with bronze facing for superior protection.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "ThrowWheelPot_Description", "Shape clay on a potters wheel for uniform, thin-walled vessels.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakePottersWheel_Description", "Construct a rotating platform for throwing pottery.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "BuildChariot_Description", "Construct a two-wheeled war chariot - the ultimate Bronze Age weapon platform.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeScaleArmor_Description", "Assemble overlapping bronze scales onto a leather backing.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "ForgeBronzeGreaves_Description", "Hammer bronze into shin guards for leg protection.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "GlazePottery_Description", "Apply mineral glazes to pottery before firing for a waterproof finish.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeGlass_Description", "Fuse sand and soda ash at high temperature to create glass.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "ShapeGlassBeads_Description", "Form molten glass into decorative beads.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "SmeltIronOre_Description", "Reduce iron ore to metal in a bloomery furnace.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "RefineIronBloom_Description", "Hammer slag from iron bloom to produce wrought iron.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "CarburizeSteel_Description", "Pack iron with charcoal and heat to absorb carbon, creating steel.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "ForgeIronSword_Description", "Hammer wrought iron into a sword blade.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "ForgeSteelSword_Description", "Create a superior sword from steel - harder and more resilient than iron.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "ForgeIronAxe_Description", "Hammer iron into an axe head.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "ForgeIronSpear_Description", "Create a socketed iron spearhead.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "ForgeIronArrowheads_Description", "Hammer small iron points for arrows.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "FletchIronArrows_Description", "Attach iron arrowheads and fletching to shafts.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeChainMail_Description", "Interlink iron rings into flexible armor.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "ForgeIronHelmet_Description", "Shape iron into a protective helmet.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "ForgeIronShield_Description", "Create a shield with iron boss and rim.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "ForgeHorseshoe_Description", "Hammer iron into a U-shaped shoe to protect horse hooves.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "ForgeIronNails_Description", "Draw iron into nails for construction.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeAnvil_Description", "Cast and shape a heavy iron anvil for smithing.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeBellows_Description", "Construct leather bellows for increasing forge temperature.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "ForgeSmithTongs_Description", "Create iron tongs for handling hot metal.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "HarvestBark_Description", "Strip bark from a tree.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "HarvestStick_Description", "Collect fallen branches and sticks.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "HarvestSap_Description", "Tap the tree for sticky resin.")
NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "ChopDownTree_Description", "Fell the tree with an axe.")

NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "BuildCampfire_Description", "Arrange stones in a ring and prepare a fire pit. The campfire is humanitys oldest technology - warmth, light, protection from predators, and the ability to cook food.")

NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "BuildForge_Description", "Construct a proper forge with stone walls, clay lining, and bellows for forced air. This enables working with copper and bronze - the metals that transformed human civilization.")

NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "BuildBloomery_Description", "Construct a tall clay furnace for smelting iron ore. The bloomery produces a spongy mass of iron bloom that must be hammered to remove impurities.")

NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "BuildWorkbench_Description", "Construct a sturdy work surface from logs and planks. A proper workbench provides stability for detailed crafting work and keeps tools organized.")

NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "BuildLoom_Description", "Construct a basic warp-weighted loom for weaving cloth. The loom enables production of textiles from plant fibers or wool.")
